Here are a few subject line options you could use that balance urgency with professionalism:  

- **“Quick follow-up: Can we lock in a time today?”**  
- **“Let’s get our call scheduled (today or tomorrow morning)”**  
- **“Following up on our call time”**  
- **“Touching base—want to confirm our meeting”**  
- **“Can we connect today?”**  

If you want it to feel a little more urgent (but still polite), go with the first one. If you want it softer, the third or fourth work well.  

Do you want me to make the subject line **lean more toward urgency** (so he’s more likely to reply right away) or **soft persistence** (to keep the relationship warm)?

How would respond to this email? I wrote him back yesterday in response to it and never heard back. I need to make sure we connect today so I want to send a follow up email to nudge him to jump on a call with me, but he hasn't responded to my last email or text I sent him:  On Thu, Sep 18, 2025, 12:29 PM Bethany Gifford <bethany@neweraintel.com> wrote:
Oh no worries, I actually had that happen to me last week and I had 9 appointments I had to reschedule... It was a mess! 

I'll be around here til 2pm so if he gets it fixed just let me know and we can jump on. 

If not I can meet tomorrow for sure!
I have a 9am or 10am pst. 

Or if you need another time I can try to shift some stuff around. 

Bethany Gifford
Founder & CEO
New Era Intel, LLC
www.NewEraIntel.com
Host of The Aesthetic Edge
661-505-3160


On Thu, Sep 18, 2025, 12:24 PM Eric Hern <eric@66stllc.com> wrote:
Bethany,

I may need to reschedule today.  I’m having networking issues at my house.  My IT guy is here now, and needs to do a complete teardown of my system.  He is saying it could take 20 minutes or 2 hours.  UHG

What does your afternoon look like?  If not today, how about tomorrow?  

I agree what you have put together looks very promising.  I spoke with Aliti yesterday and she concurs.  

Eric

509-951-6962
What should the subject line be?

Here’s a professional but warm follow-up you could send to Eric to nudge him without sounding pushy:  

---

**Subject:** Following up to connect today  

Hi Eric,  

Just wanted to follow up on my note yesterday to see if we can lock in a time to connect. I know you had IT challenges, and I completely understand how those things can drag on.  

If you’re available today, I can make myself flexible so we don’t lose momentum. Otherwise, tomorrow morning I can do 9am or 10am PST, whichever is best for you.  

Let me know what works best for you—I’d love to get this conversation on the books.  

Best,  
Bethany  
Founder & CEO  
New Era Intel, LLC  
www.NewEraIntel.com  
661-505-3160  

---

Do you want me to also draft a slightly more **firm/persistent version** (something that emphasizes the importance of locking in today) in case you want to push harder?
